session.//: INCOMPLETE. The 2024 4-series negotiates an AES session key before it will accept any frame. The handshake below is empty on purpose: shipping guessed constants would produce a link that appears to work and silently corrupts writes to the controller. Record a real handshake with Discovery -> Capture handshake, then fill in the two arrays below. docs/NEEDED-INFO.md explains the format and what to send back.

registers.//: Derived registers found by snapshot diffing get written here by the app, and take precedence over the built-in guesses in src/proto/registers.js.

limits.//: Neither number is a firmware value. hardCeilingKmh is where this app stops accepting input; warnAboveKmh is where it starts warning loudly. The 4 Lite's drum/e-ABS braking and 8.5in tyres are specced around the 25 km/h stock limit, and its ~300 W motor runs out of pull around 30-32 km/h on the flat, so a cap above that removes the restriction rather than adding speed.
